text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: One day, while I'm out with Grass<n>Wonder...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Trainer, look at all of those<n>Umamusume
plushies. They seem to<n>be prizes for that claw
machine.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm curious which racers there are.<n>Though it does
seem rather noisy<n>inside...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder is clearly interested,<n>but the shop's
atmosphere is making<n>her a little uncomfortable.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to see much of anything<n>from here. I
wonder if there's a<n>plushie of Spe or El.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Just watching from the sidelines<n>wouldn't feel
right. If only there were<n>a way I could help you, then
it would<n>be like a joint effort.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That sounds like it would help. Very<n>well, I'll be
your voice of support.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'll give it my all. Go, go, Trainer! Go,<n>go!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
